reason: Alert 1 (XSS) alert-FP: The sink at L75-77 uses encodeForHTML(str), but str is derived from param which flows through doSomething(). In doSomething(), bar = (7*18)+num>200?'This_should_always_happen':param evaluates to the CONSTANT 'This_should_always_happen' (since 126+106=232>200), not user input. Cookie values are handled differently by browsers/servers and don't enable classic response-splitting attacks. Neither alert represents an exploitable vulnerability on the analyzed path.
